answer: Proof of burn protects the raven protocol by requiring agents on each network island to provably destroy base currency via unspendable burn addresses. To register an identity, an operator must extinguish capital through a verifiable ember transaction, imposing linear, irrecoverable financial costs that prevent costless Sybil generation. However, this permanent asset destruction creates economic deadweight and still allows deep-pocketed adversaries to purchase disproportionate influence.
